description:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. 

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. 

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. 

The Role_

// We're looking for a Data Engineer to shape the data and insights behind Masabi's AI and Data Analytic product suite. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract, with potential for extension.

Every AI feature we build depends on good data: fares, journeys, accounts and transactions from transit agencies across several continents. You'll build the curated datasets and business metrics our analytics and AI products are built on, with definitions that hold across every agency, so agencies can get answers they trust and our products have what they need to work well.

You'll help agencies get to insight faster. Our AI analytics assistant is the first example of this: it lets agency teams ask questions of their data in plain language, and it's where much of the early work will focus. It's one part of a wider, AI-driven analytics product suite, so we care as much about the strength of your data foundations as about any one tool. You'll make sure the assistant has well-modelled data, clear metric definitions and the context it needs to answer accurately. Working with Product, you'll also help decide which insights matter most to agencies and how to present them.

This role would suit someone with a background in analytics or statistics who has built customer-facing analytics that people rely on, rather than one-off reports. You'll own the data models behind that work end to end, alongside a data engineering team who look after ingestion and the wider platform. We work on early proofs of concept as well as production features, often without detailed tickets, so you'll shape the work as much as deliver it.

Location_

// This role is available on a remote basis for candidates located anywhere in the UK. Candidates based in London may also work in a hybrid model, with occasional travel to the office.


Responsibilities_

  • Build and own our curated data layer, with clearly defined, documented business metrics that power analytics and AI features across Justride

  • Prepare data for our AI products, including the semantic layer, metric definitions and business context that our AI analytics assistant and other AI-driven analytics products rely on

  • Define metrics that work consistently across agencies, so performance can be compared on a like-for-like basis

  • Help bring AI-powered analytics into production, validating the queries it generates so agencies get accurate answers they can check

  • Work with AI engineers to test the accuracy of the assistant's answers, and fix the data issues behind wrong ones

  • Build data quality checks, documentation and lineage, so we know what our data means and when something looks off

  • Prepare features and datasets for machine learning colleagues

  • Handle data from many agencies securely, with the right separation and permissions

  • Support bringing in external data, such as open source transit feeds

  • Work with Product to decide which insights we offer agencies and how we present them

  • Design clear, focused dashboards and visualisations, and help improve the ones we already have

About You_

  • Hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, defining clear business metrics that analysts, products and customers rely on

  • Someone who takes initiative and is at ease with ambiguity: you can shape a loosely defined problem yourself and see it through, from proof of concept to production

  • Strong SQL and data modelling skills, with Python for analysis

  • A background in analytics or statistics, with examples of customer-facing analytics you've built

  • Experience preparing data for AI-driven analytics, such as semantic layers, text-to-SQL or knowledge bases, and curiosity about where AI-powered analytics is heading beyond any single tool

  • A talent for telling a clear story with data visualisation, choosing what to show and what to leave out

  • Some experience building data pipelines used in production

  • Real care for data quality, with experience building checks and monitoring to catch problems early

  • A good understanding of data security and privacy, especially with customer or payment data

  • Able to explain the limits of data clearly to non-technical colleagues

If you've done work like this but don't match every line, we'd still love to hear from you

Nice To Have_

  • Experience with AWS data services such as Iceberg, Athena and Lake Formation, and infrastructure as code (Terraform)

  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Spark or similar platforms

  • Experience with forecasting or statistical modelling

  • Experience with Airflow or similar tools

  • Experience with Kafka and event data

  • JVM experience (Kotlin or Java)

  • Familiarity with transit data such as GTFS

Some Of Our Benefits_

  • ﻿Competitive salary package

  • 25 days of holiday per year plus the option to buy another 5 days pro-rated

  • Private Healthcare via AXA including pre-existing conditions and mental health

  • Life Insurance

  • Menopause support

  • Choice of workstation

  • Flexibility to work from home and manage your schedule around agreed core hours (see Remote Working Policy for details)

  • Ability to work for up to 3 months per year from any country in the world (certain limitations)

  • Pension scheme

  • Training allowance of up to £1000 per year

  • £200 annual allowance for any home office need or improvement

  • Enhanced family leave pay

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Regular social gatherings with a monthly allowance for each employee

  • Fun and collaborative environment with a focus on making a difference in the world

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?
